component.name: tinyclient
component.summary: One small native app for Slack, Discord, Telegram, Teams and Signal

description.p: tinyclient signs in to your Slack workspaces, Discord, Telegram, Microsoft Teams and Signal and shows them in one window with one design. It runs entirely on your machine: it talks to each network directly, there is no tinyclient server, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

ul.li: Messages are cached on your disk; sessions are kept in the Secret Service.
No telemetry, no usage pings and no update check.
A native window, not a browser: the only web page it shows is a network's own sign-in page.
Voice calls on Discord, in a process that exists only for the length of the call.
